_comment: Captured from baselineRules.evaluateBaselineRules on staging a6947704 (BEFORE the per-utility QC rules moved to data) over the payload matrix in utilityRequirementsQc.test.ts: every result, in order, per payload; and the three rule catalogue entries. The test pins today outputs byte for byte against it. Variant 5 (a package naming only a one-line diagram) was added with the one-line SLD read (draft 12's first commit): against the code before that read, its only differences are three OR PGE payloads (PGE, Portland General Electric, P.G.E.) that no longer warn 'PGE package may be missing: SLD/3-line.'; the first four variants are unchanged.
